name: gallery
title: Gallery
description: A product's photos to swipe, with thumbnails named by their view, on Swiper 14.3.0: the same gallery as the plain-JS dist/ud-gallery.js.
docs: Import Swiper's own stylesheet once beside the tokens (@import "swiper/css/bundle"); the skin is ud-gallery in dist/tokens.css of the same release, shared with dist/ud-gallery.js. Give each photo its copies (srcSet, such as 160, 640 and 1200px), the slide's width (sizes), its own alt and its view's name (label); every photo waits until it is near, the opening one too, and priority loads the page's main image at once and fetches it first (dist/ud-gallery.js keeps UDesign Pages' markup, its opening photo at once). A new set of photos, such as another colour's, is a new gallery that opens on start. The arrow keys move only the gallery that has the focus or the pointer, never every gallery on screen; Page Up and Page Down scroll the page. Motion follows --motion-duration-standard, 0ms under reduced motion. Screen-reader words follow <html lang> (French, or English for en), or messages. Not in core: it adds swiper. See DESIGN.md "Showing photos".
